source.title: GT-G3-00 G3 Basic Canonical Canvas P30 Implementation Plan v0.1

trusted_statements.goal: Add a Headless Canvas Demo CLI that opens one checked-in fixed canonical fixture, drives it through the production G2 scene and G3 Render Core pipeline, and emits independently verifiable raster, digest, and evidence artifacts.
owns: one opt-in Headless Canvas Demo executable
one checked-in G3-07 fixture descriptor and independent expected artifact oracle
deterministic command-line parsing and atomic artifact publication
demo-local assembly of existing canonical/runtime/render owners without changing their contracts
produces: deterministic nonzero process status on failure

fixed_cli_contract.failure_exit: nonzero for argument, input, decode/bootstrap, scene/runtime, render, or artifact-publication failure
fixed_cli_contract.publication: All three outputs become visible as one successful set through same-filesystem temporary staging and rename; a failed run leaves no new success evidence and never mixes old and new artifacts.

fixed_fixture_contract.format: canonical SemanticSnapshot v1 bytes decoded with SnapshotCodec and restored with SnapshotBootstrapper; no test-only object-store mutator
fixed_fixture_contract.content: Exactly one valid distinguishable object of each V1 ObjectKind with stable IDs 501 through 509, deterministic order, non-empty geometry for the eight pixel-contributing kinds, Group retained as zero-pixel traversal, and a supported simple FilledPath erase mask on Shape.
fixed_fixture_contract.oracle_independence: The expected descriptor is checked in by P32 from package literals and review-owned hash calculation; the CLI and SkiaHeadlessBackend may not generate or rewrite it.

trusted_statements.pipeline_invariant: The fixture must be decoded and restored into canonical semantic storage, projected through production Scene and RuntimeScene, queried by VisibilityResolver, mapped by DirectReferenceSource, built by FramePlanBuilder, submitted by FrameOrchestrator to SkiaHeadlessBackend, and only then observed. The CLI must not construct a final ReferenceDrawList or FramePlan directly and must not call test-only access seams.
forbidden: direct SemanticDocument or ObjectStore traversal for rendering
manual construction of final RuntimeSceneRecord, VisibilityResult, ReferenceDrawList, ReferenceTraversalEntry, ReferenceCommand, or FramePlan values in the CLI
test-only fixture/access helpers or friend-only mutation seams
changes to RuntimeScene, Scene, Render Core, SurfaceLifecycle, PresentationTracker, Headless backend, or any existing G3-01 through G3-06 public contract
CanonicalVisible, FrameCoverageManifest, Arc token/preview clearing, G4 Arc or Ink
camera interaction, hit/select, platform host, native surface, scheduler, Tile, RenderGroup, RasterCache, ResourceBudget, or final FrameGraph behavior
Skia lock/profile/producer changes or a source build
